purpose: Versioned per-token and presegmented-sequence parity inputs. Expected values are generated by the pinned upstream implementation during CI; this corpus is not a linguistic gold set. Known leading-ho-hip vowel-order corrections are validated explicitly and may intentionally differ from upstream. The corpus includes source-attested lexical corrections; these are checked against the reviewed output and reported as intentional divergences when the upstream rule port differs. Context-dependent marks and unreviewed ทร tokens are tested as explicit abstentions, not silently dropped or guessed. Long unreviewed proper-name tokens are also expected to abstain rather than be treated as a trustworthy concatenated romanization.
